name: Calving separation
notes: Combined adjusted estimates for all comparator categories into a single comparator, weighted by category sample sizes. The joint effect of the combined OR and the estimate for calves only being born in the calving area was then estimated by multiplying their adjusted odds ratios and approximating the 95% confidence interval by summing variances on the log-odds scale under an independence assumption.
